title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Carrying a Lapsed Travel Credit onto a Fresh Voucher
content:
Where a travel credit issued under Air Ticket Fare Brands has lapsed on a booking, the value it carried may be put back into use on a fresh voucher in the traveller's own name. This policy governs that fresh voucher: one is minted and the matching issue line posted to the booking's credit ledger, so the booking afterwards carries an open travel credit of the value named, redeemable until the last date given, while the lapsed lines stay on the record as they were. The traveller sees a new voucher code to quote and the value standing open again.

The value carried onto the fresh voucher is fixed only after the reissue fee owed under the fare brand that produced the lapsed voucher stands as a charged line on the booking.

**Situation of use and capability.** The instrument carries the value of a lapsed travel credit onto a fresh voucher in the traveller's own name; one call mints one voucher and posts one issue line.

**How it is invoked.** The instrument is `reissue_lapsed_travel_credit_f544c035`. It is unlocked and then called; because the call spends the traveller's one chance to put that value back into use, the unlock is handed over and run by the customer themselves.

**What it takes.**

- `air_booking_id` — the reference number of the air booking record whose lapsed travel credit is being carried forward, as returned by the air booking lookup for this traveller.
- `source_event_id` — the reference number of the lapsed travel credit line on the same booking whose value is carried onto the fresh voucher, as returned by the air booking event lookup.
- `passenger_sequence` — which traveller on the booking the fresh voucher is issued for, in ticket order, written as a whole number starting at 1. There is no empty value and no rounding.
- `credit_expires_on` — the last date the fresh voucher may be redeemed, written as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, with no time part. There is no empty value, because every voucher carries a last date.
- `carried_value_usd` — the value placed on the fresh voucher, as a positive US dollar amount with 2 decimal places, given to the cent exactly as the published terms produce it. US dollars only, and there is no empty value.

**What comes back.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the fresh voucher code minted, beginning with the letters WLTR, the reference of the new issue line, a string beginning "arew_", the air booking reference it was posted to, the value placed on the fresh voucher in US dollars to two decimal places, and the last date it may be redeemed. Receiving that sentence means the fresh voucher now stands open in the traveller's name.
